decisions.reason: The rejection restricts v to x(t,supp nu), but post-cm10-rigid-material (ii) defines the placement on all R^3 and def-cm10-rigid-body-configuration (e) defines v on its full image, also all R^3. At the fixed placement c'(t)=v(t,c(t)); equality of full-field differences gives equal cross-product matrices, hence equal angular velocities by the skew-matrix supplier. Two independent test vectors suffice since a vector parallel to both must vanish. The point-mass restriction is indeed non-identifying, but it is not the defined full-field domain. Clauses (a)-(f), C^1 rates, rotation conjugation and the explicit axis converse are sound. No final item or contract edit.

Final focused depcheck examined the actual prerequisite graph across 1184 closure items and 287 pages and reported no cycles or other errors. The Remark's link is a deferred same-page result, not a prerequisite: symmetry and semidefiniteness use the mathematical inertia-properties lemma, while axis invariance and invertibility are explicitly deferred. Finite bounded centred positive mass and AC_omega match the moment and shifted-integral suppliers; R^T(p-c) and conjugation correctly define all shifted tensors. No item or metadata edit is needed.

The original physical path uses seconds as a radian argument with no inverse-time coefficient. Added a positive model rate kappa in radians/second, R(t)=Ry(kappa t), c=0 on I0=R and omega=kappa e2. The derivative is kappa Ry(kappa t)[e2]_cross, so R^T R'=[kappa e2]_cross; the dimensionless-angle and inverse-time-rate declarations now match def-cm01-units. Pole collisions, nonzero kernel (1,0,-1), and the conjugated pole-rate formula remain valid. Distinguished a dimensionless angle shift s from a rate shift h and made the Given curve C^2 to match the model. This is a missing dimensional convention, not a failure of the pole calculation. Focused precheck and rendercheck passed.

The two-atom witness and I=diag(2m0 a^2,2m0 a^2,0) are valid, but the parameter and output dimensions were implicit. Given now declares m0 in kilograms, a in metres, varpi in radians/second and inertia, energy and angular-momentum units. The finite-simple minorant yields the signed atomic integral; centredness is exact; Rz(varpi t) fixes both physical labels, and Ie3=0 forces zero rotational energy and Lc. No false certainty or empirical values are introduced. Also corrected Tong Eq. (3.22) from printed p.52/PDF p.58 to p.51/PDF p.57 after reading the complete local source discussion through /tmp/batch26-tong.pdf pages 56-58 with PyMuPDF; the source's loose word positive is qualified by its actual nonnegative inequality and rod example. Focused precheck and rendercheck passed.

The finite-atomic triangle calculation is correct, but m0, a, inertia and energy units were implicit. Declared m0 in kilograms, a and xk in metres, dimensionless basis and angles, omega_j and varpi in radians/second, moments in kilogram metres squared and rotational energy in joules. Independent checks give sum xk=0 and sum xk xk^T=diag(3a^2/2,3a^2/2,0), hence the stated inertia; no line contains two atoms, and Rz(2pi/3) permutes them, so SIS^T=I. The repeated transverse eigenvalue permits exactly any orthonormal planar pair. The formula 1/2 omega^T I omega has energy dimension after these declarations. No mathematical proportion, support, regularity, dynamics or empirical claim changes. Focused precheck, rendercheck and strict contract check passed.

The original tensor I(0,ae1) is undefined when 0 is outside the permitted open time window, and evaluating a reference placement requires c=0 and R=I3 at the evaluation time. Clauses 2-4 and their proofs now use an explicitly assumed t_* in I0 with (c(t_*),R(t_*))=(0,I3); constant reference motions show admissibility on every permitted interval, while clause 1 remains universal for all t in I0 and all motions. Conjugating the centred supplier with a=R^T(p-c) yields the spatial shift. At t_* the shift is 3m0 a^2 diag(0,1,1); adding it gives diag(3m0 a^2/2,9m0 a^2/2,6m0 a^2). The direct atom displacements (0,0,0),(-3a/2,+/-sqrt(3)a/2,0) give the same matrix and e3-axis difference ma^2. This repairs the missing domain hypothesis without changing the promised reference-placement calculation or universal spatial identity. SI dimensions inherit the corrected triangle; no measurement is asserted. Focused precheck and rendercheck passed.
